verdict.rationale: Smithery is a SaaS MCP registry and connection platform that handled user credentials and tool calls, so a data-training opt-out or no-training policy is a fair question for it. The evidence pack has no statement about AI training use of customer data and no opt-out control. Encrypted credential storage and scoped service tokens are adjacent security features, not a training-data protection, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
